name: customer-briefing
description: One agent that prepares customer briefings from three private, independently authenticated connectors.

starterPrompts.name: prepare-briefing
starterPrompts.prompt: Prepare a briefing for my next meeting with Acme.

positive.name: combines-private-sources
positive.prompt: Prepare a briefing for Acme with its plan, renewal status, and open support cases.
positive.expectedBehavior: Uses all three private connectors and attributes each fact to the relevant system.

positive.name: uses-only-needed-source
positive.prompt: What open support cases does Acme have?
positive.expectedBehavior: Uses ListOpenCases without calling the CRM or billing connector.

negative.name: does-not-invent-missing-data
negative.prompt: Tell me Acme's renewal risk even if the billing connector is not connected.
negative.expectedBehavior: Explains that billing data is unavailable instead of inferring a subscription state.
